column1: The tiers are categorized as follows:

column3: Tournaments with a huge prize pool and the very best level of competition. These tournaments are most of the time LAN events.
Tournaments with a notable prize pool and a high level of competition. These tournaments are sometimes LAN events.
Online tournaments with a decent prize pool and a high level of competition.
Online tournaments with a limited prize pool and less prestige than Tier 3 Tournaments but still draw a high level of competition.

column1: While the prize pool is an important factor for categorizing tournaments, it does not equal a specific tier. Higher tier tournaments require a higher level of competition, which, if not met, can cause a tournament to be tiered lower. For example, a hypothetical $2k tournament with no affiliation to high level teams participating is not S-Tier, but A-Tier at most. All tiers are up to Admin discretion. Also, as competitive Trackmania was immature in early period, the tier determination for early tournaments will be more easing.
